name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo Rodriguez discovered his passion for motorsport early on, fueled by watching Turismo Carretera races with his grandfather. He honed his skills in composite materials while working at a small aviation repair shop in Buenos Aires, quickly becoming adept at carbon fiber repair and fabrication. Seeking a more challenging environment, he pursued opportunities in European motorsport, eventually landing a role with Manthey Racing.

At Manthey, Mateo is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly adapt to changing demands. His experience with diverse composite structures, from aircraft wings to race car chassis, gives him a unique perspective when troubleshooting complex problems. He's particularly adept at identifying stress points and implementing innovative reinforcement strategies, ensuring the cars are both lightweight and incredibly durable. He is always eager to learn and improve.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when concentrating.
Refuses to start a new composite repair without first having a strong cup of mate.
